title: Fully decompiled D&D Dragonlance Shadow Sorcerer (Baldur's Gate 3 from 1991). Also modded it to properly support mouse. Ported to SDL3 and asm.js. Took a week with local Qwen3.8-flash-next (nvfp4) and Ghidra.
author: OkShock6767

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/OkShock6767, this falls under Rule 4. Commercial posts are okay here, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).

replies.author: OkShock6767
replies.body: The post says that I used Qwen3.8-flash-next (nvfp4) and Ghidra. No actual code was written by hand, but I did some key prompting to compile and refactor Ghidra's output into manageable codebase. There were no problems, outside of AI being conservative and requiring explicit prompt to refactor obviously code. Also this is not a commercial post, since I dont take money.
